# bioexcel/biobb_gromacs_convert_tpr

## Summary

Wrapper of the GROMACS convert-tpr module.

The GROMACS convert-tpr module can edit run input files (.tpr): modify the run length (extend/until/nsteps) or trim the tpr file to a subset of atoms defined in an index file (input_ndx_path). Note that GROMACS does not allow both operations in a single call, so when an index file is provided the extend/until/nsteps properties are ignored.

Nextflow adapter of the [ConvertTpr](https://biobb-gromacs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gromacs.html#module-gromacs.convert_tpr) building block of [biobb_gromacs](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_gromacs) 5.3.2.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_GROMACS_CONVERT_TPR } from 'bioexcel/biobb_gromacs_convert_tpr'

workflow {
    BIOBB_GROMACS_CONVERT_TPR(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_tpr_path` | yes | tpr | Path to the input portable binary run file TPR |
| `input_ndx_path` | no | ndx | Path to the input index NDX file, used to trim the tpr file to a subset of atoms |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>.<role>.<extension>`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_tpr_path` | yes | tpr | Path to the output portable binary run file TPR |
| `versions_biobb_gromacs` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_gromacs', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of ConvertTpr properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension (for example `[output_tpr_path: 'tpr']`). Optional outputs set to `false` are not requested |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_gromacs container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_GROMACS_CONVERT_TPR' {
        ext.properties = [extend: 0]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `extend` | integer | 0 | Extend the runtime by this amount (ps). |
| `until` | integer | 0 | Extend the runtime until this ending time (ps). |
| `nsteps` | integer | 0 | Change the number of steps remaining to be made. |
| `output_group` | string | "System" | Index group to write to the output tpr file when trimming to a subset of atoms. Only used when input_ndx_path is provided. |
| `gmx_lib` | string | null | Path set GROMACS GMXLIB environment variable. |
| `binary_path` | string | "gmx" | Path to the GROMACS executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
